1.title: Minimal studio product hero
1.notes: A single cobalt dropper bottle is crisp on a warm gradient, with soft shadow and restrained reflection.
1.alt: 蓝色滴管瓶置于暖色渐变背景，主体清晰，柔影和倒影克制。

2.title: Pure-white commerce packshot
2.notes: A complete white fabric-covered speaker is centered on white with a contact shadow and no added text.
2.alt: 白色织物音箱完整居中，白底、接触阴影，无额外文字。

3.title: Three-quarter ceramic packaging view
3.notes: The elevated three-quarter view exposes the sculptural lid top and hollow side handle, preserving the reference speckled ceramic and gold collar.

4.title: Floating product packshot
4.notes: The silver mouse has a visible air gap above its separate soft shadow; the full silhouette and scroll wheel are intact.
4.alt: 银色鼠标与地面阴影之间有明确间隙，轮廓和滚轮完整。

5.title: Leather stitching macro
5.notes: Leather grain and cream stitching are sharp near the wallet corner, with directional side light and shallow focus.
5.alt: 钱包转角的皮革纹理和奶油色缝线清晰，侧光与浅景深符合要求。

6.title: Top-down product detail
6.notes: Top-down espresso-machine controls show coherent buttons and brushed metal, with a softly blurred countertop. The machine is a fictional concept.
6.alt: 俯拍咖啡机按钮与拉丝金属，台面柔和虚化；机器为虚构概念。

7.title: Morning lifestyle product scene
7.notes: A linen pouch is the focal point on a linen-covered table, lit from a left window with a notebook nearby.
7.alt: 亚麻收纳包是桌面焦点，左侧晨光与旁边笔记本形成生活场景。

8.title: Product in natural use
8.notes: A natural hand adjusts a coral desk fan; object scale and tabletop contact are coherent in warm light.
8.alt: 自然手势调节珊瑚色桌面风扇，尺度与桌面接触关系合理。

9.title: Seasonal brand scene
9.notes: An amber sports bottle stands among restrained autumn leaves by a lake; the bottle remains dominant.
9.alt: 琥珀色运动水瓶置于秋叶与湖景前，产品仍为视觉主体。

10.title: Promotional poster with copy space
10.notes: A green tea tin occupies the lower portion of a cobalt poster, leaving the top clear for later copy.
10.alt: 深绿茶罐位于钴蓝海报下方，上部留有清晰文案空间。

29.title: Coloring sheet with color guide

31.title: Chinese citrus tea launch poster

32.title: Coffee journey infographic

33.title: Fictional character relationship map

33.alt: 三个人物形成清晰三角关系，搭档、寻找与兄妹连接指定角色，搭档关系为双向。

34.title: Blue-and-white porcelain diagram
34.notes: A complete central vase has six separated callouts, with the requested Chinese labels readable. This is a generated exhibit-layout concept.

35.title: Museum-style folding-fan breakdown
35.notes: Title, separated fan parts, material samples and four-stage process occupy the requested regions; all requested short labels are readable.
35.alt: 标题、折扇部件、材质样本与四步流程位于指定区域，要求的短标签清晰。

36.title: Swallow silhouette narrative poster
36.notes: A clear flying swallow contains a lighthouse, town, lit path and traveler in a watercolor world with generous paper margins.
36.alt: 清晰飞燕轮廓内包含灯塔、小镇、灯光归途与旅人，水彩纸纹和留白明显。

37.title: Dense Chinese layout stress test
37.notes: All 24 source lines appear once across the title and three columns; the original date, hours and location are retained.
37.alt: 标题与三栏共完整呈现24行原稿，每行一次；日期、时间及地点保持。

38.title: Butterfly encyclopedia layout
38.notes: Main butterfly, two magnified details, five topic modules and five butterfly groups are visible. The model expanded the short copy; this is a layout study, not a scientifically reviewed teaching sheet.
38.alt: 主蝴蝶、两处放大、五个知识模块和五类蝴蝶可见。模型扩写了原短文案，本例仅作版式研究，未经过科学内容审校。

39.title: One hundred technology topics
39.notes: The complete ten-by-ten grid contains 100 distinct labeled cells in the requested row order. The small scenes are illustrative, not engineering diagrams.
39.alt: 完整10×10网格包含100个不同标签，按指定行序排列；小场景属于主题插图，并非工程图。

40.title: Fitness-card layout concept
40.notes: Four named movement panels and the warm-up, progression, alternative and recovery modules are readable. The model added explanations; the image is a layout concept, not validated exercise instruction.
40.alt: 四个动作区及热身、进阶、替代、恢复模块清晰；模型添加了说明，本图仅作版式概念，未作为训练指导验证。

41.title: Cabin sketch to realistic rendering
41.notes: The gable, front door, three windows and three steps preserve the sketch arrangement and perspective, with wood, metal and concrete materials added.
41.alt: 坡屋顶、前门、三窗与三级台阶保留草图布局及透视，补充木材、金属与混凝土材质。

42.title: Floor plan to blueprint axonometric
42.notes: Two rooms, the offset divider, two windows and both doors correspond to the plan. This is the first generated view; the separately recorded reverse-view step uses this image as its input.
42.alt: 两房、偏置隔墙、双窗与两扇门对应平面图。本图为第一轮轴测，另存的反向视角运行以本图为输入。

43.title: Terrazzo floor material replacement
43.notes: Only the visible floor becomes green terrazzo; the rug, furniture, door and window retain their positions and shapes.
43.alt: 可见地板变为绿色水磨石，地毯、家具、门窗的位置和形状保持。

44.title: Reference sofa replacement
44.notes: The orange corduroy sofa replaces the teal sofa and its cushions; the remaining room arrangement and daylight are preserved.
44.alt: 橙色灯芯绒沙发替换蓝绿沙发及其抱枕，其他室内布局与日光保持。

45.title: Furnish an empty bedroom
45.notes: A warm bedroom is furnished along the left wall; the original rear window, right door and camera view are retained.
45.alt: 左墙新增温暖卧室布置，原后窗、右门与相机视角保持。

46.title: Clay model to material visualization

47.title: Daylight interior to night
47.notes: The original lamp glows warmly, the window turns dark blue, and all main objects and the camera remain fixed.
47.alt: 原落地灯亮起暖光，窗外变深蓝夜色，主要物品与相机位置保持。

48.title: Interior furnishings catalog board
48.notes: Six numbered products occupy the requested groups. The sofa has no loose cushions, and the standalone cushion appears only once.
48.alt: 六件编号单品归入指定分组，沙发已去掉独立抱枕，同款抱枕仅展示一次。

49.alt: 双手托起完整钩织玩偶，短发、红眼镜及黄绿服装保留合成参考特征。

50.title: Portrait to desk figurine
50.notes: The full figure stands on a round desktop base; pose, bob haircut, red glasses and outfit colors remain recognizable.
50.alt: 完整手办立于桌面圆底座，站姿、短发、红眼镜和服装配色可辨。

51.title: Portrait to bookshelf bobblehead

55.title: Portrait to rubber keychain

56.title: Portrait to enamel pin

56.alt: 单枚全身徽章采用亮金属边和饱和珐琅，保留参考发型、眼镜与服装配色。

57.title: Cherry pixel-style icon
57.notes: Two cherries and joined stems are recognizable with hard block edges on white. Some internal tonal variation remains; this is a raster concept, not a cleaned pixel sprite.
